title: Buffer value in the tape assembly
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type, let $k,l$ be nonnegative integers, let $a$ and $c$ be families of values indexed by the $k$ left positions and $l$ right positions, respectively, and let $b\in\alpha$. The three-block assembly of $a$, $b$, and $c$ takes the value $b$ at its middle buffer position.
hypotheses_covered: A family $a$ indexed by the $k$ left positions
A family $c$ indexed by the $l$ right positions
An index in the single middle buffer position
replaced:
Let $a$ be a family of values on $k$ indices, $b$ a single value, and $c$ a
family of values on $l$ indices.  Evaluating their three-block assembly at
the middle buffer index returns $b$.
